source_texts: Horizonte padrão é 30 dias e reutiliza exatamente `referenceDate`, `openingBalance` e série de #617.
`minimumProjectedBalance` considera a posição inicial e todos os 30 fechamentos.
`minimumBalanceOn` usa a primeira ocorrência temporal, incluindo `referenceDate` em caso de empate.
`freeToSpend` corresponde ao menor colchão financeiro não negativo da trajetória.
Déficit intermediário não é mascarado por receita posterior.
Orçamento sem compromisso materializado não reduz `freeToSpend`.
Transferência futura BRL -> USD afeta os dois indicadores apenas pelos respectivos pontos das séries de #617, sem compensação/conversão em #618.
Dado obrigatório insuficiente produz `unavailable` e omite campos numéricos sintéticos.
Saldo bruto, livre para gastar e déficit projetado são semanticamente distintos na UI/API.
Drilldown do ponto limitante reutiliza a evidência retornada pela projeção, sem recálculo frontend.

risk_surfaces.reason: Opening-balance provenance must survive canonical projection reuse.
Unavailable state must not expose synthetic numeric values at the public API boundary.
Canonical documentation must match the runtime availability semantics.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Build a complete 30-day currency trajectory from a future commitment using an implicit opening zero and then publish that structurally valid block as available.

positive_control.procedure: Run the full exact-head Delivery V2 CI including domain tests, API integration tests and build.
positive_control.expected: All issue 618 behavioral and integration regressions pass on the material head.
positive_control.observed: Delivery V2 CI run 36035406314 completed success on the exact material head.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A structurally complete projection can be published from synthesized numeric state when a mandatory source is absent.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a projected currency block as sufficient provenance even when that currency exists only because a future commitment introduced it.
negative_controls.procedure: Call the 30-day projection without a currency filter after creating a future EUR card invoice but no active EUR account, while keeping a real zero-balance JPY account.
negative_controls.expected: Only currencies backed by a real active-account opening-balance source may publish numeric free-to-spend values.
negative_controls.observed: Exact-head API integration observes commitment-only EUR as unavailable and real-zero JPY as available.
